products.name: HireVue
products.note: Video interviewing AI; facial analysis controversy; algorithmic hiring bias; regulatory scrutiny

profile_text.body:
HireVue is a for-profit company founded in 2004 and headquartered in South Jordan, Utah. The company describes itself as a provider of AI-powered video interviewing, assessments, and candidate skill validation tools, positioning its platform as a way for employers to evaluate candidates and identify talent without in-person campus visits.

HireVue's core product is its video interviewing and assessment platform, which the company markets particularly toward early-talent and graduate recruiting. The product has attracted attention for its use of algorithmic hiring tools and has faced controversy over facial analysis and concerns about algorithmic bias, as well as regulatory scrutiny.

The company is a defendant in Rodrigues v. HireVue, Inc., a case filed in the District Court for the Western District of Missouri, and carries noted legal exposure in Utah, where it is headquartered.
